finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::the url printed for headless copy-paste omits `clistate`, so the documented headless flow always produces an unbound callback and steers users to `--allow-unbound-callback`
evidence: Verified in login.ts:72–90: the always-printed URL omits cliState and the full URL appears only in the catch around open(). The `open` package resolves without waiting for the opener to succeed, so on stub-xdg-open/WSL-style environments the user only sees the nonce-less URL; visiting it yields a redirect with no state (auth.controller.ts:127–133), which the listener rejects with UNBOUND_CALLBACK_MESSAGE (login.ts:257–265) blaming server version skew and recommending --allow-unbound-callback. The claim's "always" is slightly overstated (a genuinely failed open() prints the full URL), but the core defect — a copy-paste path the design doc still advertises (cli.md step 3) that produces a misleading error steering users to disable the injection binding — is present as described.
